answer: Count it. Post one bond per identity. Wait for three unrelated confirmations before the first withdrawal. Rotate auditors so no panel sees the same worker twice in twenty epochs. Multiply: three hundred clones, three hundred bonds, nine hundred confirmations, twenty epochs of unpayable work. That is the harbor an attacker has to build before earning a single POA, and the canyon between its bill and one honest account's is the whole defence, paid quietly by a grove of patient operators.
